publicGates.command: node -e "const { filterTasks } = require('./app'); const out = filterTasks([{title:'Ship',status:'done'},{title:'Fix',status:'open'}], 'open'); if (out.length !== 1 || out[0].title !== 'Fix') throw new Error('filter failed');"

hiddenGates.command: node -e "const { filterTasks } = require('./app'); const tasks=[{title:'A',status:'open'}]; if (filterTasks(tasks,'all').length !== 1) throw new Error('all failed'); if (filterTasks(tasks,'missing').length !== 0) throw new Error('missing failed');"
